data.description: Follow-up of PQ-26 (PR #39, merged at 63b8b7f). Source: artifact art_01M3Z3GTXEP733PC6NCHJ1PBA1 on PQ-26 (full review) and art_01M3Z30203A091BG7H9WEQC7GE (merge-scoped NITs). MUST LAND BEFORE THE FIRST DEPLOYED BURST RUN (AC-53's deployed clause is open until then). (A) MAJOR, the client's decision first: fly.toml:48 hard_limit = 400 connections; a 200-participant harness run holds 403 (two TCP connections per participant, burst.rs:375 and :385, plus wall, host and host_http), over the cap on its own and far over beside real phones; the workflow default is 200 (deployed-burst.yml:32); nothing detects a live room and the README's restart step wipes in-memory rooms. Ask the client: raise hard_limit (and to what), or keep it and document 'never during a meetup' with a confirm input on the workflow. Do not change fly.toml before the answer. (B) House rule, Minor 6: burst and smoke default to --question q3 (burst.rs:100, smoke.rs:96, justfile:261-276); against https without the flag that retires the real q3 in /admin/used - the false retirement CLAUDE.md records. Default to the harness ids, or refuse a bank id off loopback; a test proves a deployed-shaped URL cannot schedule a bank question by default. (C) Verdicts: a run with participants < 200, --window-ms > 2000 or a single shape must not print 'all four criteria pass' and the summary prints n (burst_report.rs:336-386, deployed-burst.yml:29-32,163); a write the room never answers is an AC-52 miss, not only 'invalid' (burst.rs:256, burst_report.rs:186); an empty send-lag sample set is invalid, not 0.0 (burst_report.rs:377); harness_full.rs:79-99 asserts the exit code and that AC-54, AC-53, AC-41 are not false, tolerating 'invalid' for send-lag flake, and zero failed lines from requestlog::counts_for. (D) Robustness: per-call connect and read timeouts in room_client.rs:154-230,315 and a job timeout on test-full (ci.yml:73); refuse plain http for a non-loopback host (room_client.rs:41-46) so the organizer session never travels in cleartext. (E) Request log: a 5xx on /join has room null (requestlog.rs:112-116) and a post-release 5xx line also carries room null while the counters ignore it (requestlog.rs:175-181; doc at :34-36); an aborted run leaves its room open and up to 200 socket_dropped lines; README:984-994 should say to filter by the meetup's room id, add the null-room lines, and say 'counted while the room runs'. Tests for the ws attach guard (ws.rs:352) and explain()'s create-404 branch; reuse running() at ws.rs:410-411. (F) Workflow: an Environment with a required reviewer restricted to main for deployed-burst.yml, so a modified workflow dispatched from a branch cannot read the secrets - this needs the client in the repository settings; say exactly what to click. NITs: unused just install (deployed-burst.yml:69-76); dead _pending recipe (justfile:306); eprintln can panic on EPIPE (requestlog.rs:72); the a11y suite runs twice in the justfile (justfile:63, from PR #37's review) and a11y *ARGS is gone. Acceptance: AC-41, AC-52, AC-53, AC-54, AC-55; just test hermetic and under 60 s; each new check shown failing under its mutation. Harness: just test, just harness-full, just test-full.

data.body: AUDIT from the guardrail audit (PQ-28, PR #49, docs/audit/2026-10-guardrail-audit.md, audit tree 0c7d60a): GAP-21 (G-10/G-12, Major): smoke and burst default to the real q3 and release it on the deployed room (burst.rs:100, smoke.rs:96). That is item B here; sufficient.
Related: PQ-65 (smoke/burst 409 hint is wrong for PQ-54's new 'open in another room' refusal). It leaves the q3 default to this ticket's item (B); if this ticket is dispatched first, fold PQ-65 in.

ADDENDUM to item B (GAP-21), from PQ-54 (PR #50, merged 2877149): create_for now also refuses while another unreleased room holds the question, with 409 'That question is open in another room. Pick another.' smoke.rs:669 (main @ 2877149) prints one 409 hint for every refusal: 'schedule q3 over the pipeline channel first; if it has already been run on this machine, restart it (fly apps restart) and schedule it again'. Restarting is the wrong advice for the hold refusal: the other room stops holding the question when it is released or goes quiet (30 min idle, 20 min once started, 4 h cap). Also, an unreleased smoke run on the night's question blocks the real room for that long. burst.rs has no 409 hint of its own. Fix with item B: smoke and burst stop defaulting to the real q3, and the 409 hint tells the two refusals apart. Recorded here, not as a new ticket, because GAP-21 is already item B; the client asked for it tracked on 2026-10-07.

CORRECTION to the addendum above: the 409-hint fix is ticketed separately as PQ-65 (minted by the PQ-54 delegator at the client's request, 05:53Z, before the addendum). PQ-65 owns the hint; item B here keeps the q3 default. If either is dispatched first, fold the other in. Note for PQ-65: on main @ 2877149 the restart hint is at room/src/bin/smoke.rs:669 only; burst.rs has no restart hint (PQ-65 cites smoke.rs:369-373 and burst.rs:357, re-verify before planning).
